_comment: Third-party runtimes the installer downloads (or takes from -ComponentsDir for offline installs). Each file is verified against its SHA-256 before use. Pinned and verified 2026-10-12.

python.note: Official CPython build published on nuget.org by the Python team; python.exe Authenticode-signed by the Python Software Foundation. Portable: no installer, no admin.

postgresql.note: EDB's official Windows binaries (the files the PostgreSQL installer installs). Only bin, lib and share are extracted.

winsw.note: Windows Service Wrapper (MIT), latest stable release; runs the web, worker and tunnel as Windows services.
